passage:
The city built a new path through the park. It was smooth and wide, good for bikes, wheelchairs, and strollers.
Before the path, many people crossed the grass, making muddy lines after rain. Some said people were careless. But a city worker explained that people often create paths where they need to go.
The new path followed the muddy line. After it opened, the grass began to grow back.
The park looked better, and people moved more safely.
The project showed that good design listens to behavior. Instead of only telling people where to walk, the city studied where people already walked and built a better way.
